title: Kissed Indulgent German Beef Terrine
description: A grassy and indulgent German dish featuring gelatine leaves, this terrine is perfect for special occasions, made in a bamboo tray and cooked in a bain-marie for a tender and aerated texture.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 150 degrees Celsius.
Soak the gelatine leaves in cold water for 5 minutes.
In a large pan, combine the sliced onion, grated carrot, and sliced celery, and cook over low heat until the vegetables are softened.
Add the beef to the pan and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the beef broth, white wine, black pepper, and salt to the pan, and stir to combine.
Remove the gelatine leaves from the water and add them to the pan, stirring to combine.
Pour the mixture into a bamboo tray and place the tray in a bain-marie.
Cook the terrine in the preheated oven for 2 hours.
Remove the terrine from the oven and let it cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate the terrine for at least 4 hours before serving.
